1	import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'
2	import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
3	
4	const routes = [
5	  { path: '/login', name: 'Login', component: () => import('@/views/LoginView.vue'), meta: { guest: true } },
6	  { path: '/register', name: 'Register', component: () => import('@/views/RegisterView.vue'), meta: { guest: true } },
7	  {
8	    path: '/',
9	    component: () => import('@/layouts/MobileLayout.vue'),
10	    meta: { requiresAuth: true },
11	    children: [
12	      { path: '', name: 'Dashboard', component: () => import('@/views/DashboardView.vue') },
13	      { path: 'holdings', name: 'Holdings', component: () => import('@/views/HoldingsView.vue') },
14	      { path: 'watchlist', name: 'Watchlist', component: () => import('@/views/WatchlistView.vue') },
15	      { path: 'transactions', name: 'Transactions', component: () => import('@/views/TransactionsView.vue') },
16	      { path: 'stock/:ticker', name: 'StockDetail', component: () => import('@/views/StockDetailView.vue') },
17	      { path: 'position/:ticker', name: 'PositionDetail', component: () => import('@/views/PositionDetailView.vue') },
18	      { path: 'profile', name: 'Profile', component: () => import('@/views/ProfileView.vue') },
19	    ],
20	  },
21	  { path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', redirect: '/' },
22	]
23	
24	const router = createRouter({
25	  history: createWebHistory(),
26	  routes,
27	  scrollBehavior: () => ({ top: 0 }),
28	})
29	
30	router.beforeEach((to) => {
31	  const auth = useAuthStore()
32	  if (to.meta.requiresAuth && !auth.token) return { name: 'Login' }
33	  if (to.meta.guest && auth.token) return { name: 'Dashboard' }
34	})
35	
36	export default router
37
